nonclaims: No claim that no conceivable provider implementation exists elsewhere.
No authorization to build a provider for this experiment.
assessment.reason: The fresh bounded connector and immutable deployed-source review did not identify an already-existing executable surface that can be proven against the complete frozen slot_capture contract. Absence of matching symbols alone is not a universal non-existence proof; it is sufficient here only to refuse activation because the registration requires positive provider proof.

transport_roundtrip_source.assessment: Transport roundtrip is an execution-intent challenge/verification/consumption surface; this observation does not establish the frozen provider-owned per-slot admission state machine.

purpose: Reassess the frozen pre-existing slot_capture provider prerequisite at the registered review boundary without creating or integrating a provider.
